authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: Full vidyullatā gives Prakrit vijjullayā/vijjuliā/vijjulī, regional bijulī/bijlī and Gujarati vijḷī lightning. These support βidzaḷi/vižəḷi/vidzḷi/bidzali/bijale/bidzale and provisionally ijiḷi with initial loss. Preserve lateral quality and final vowels; local changes and cross-IA transmission are qualified. The longer l-containing family is not collapsed into bare vidyut. Exact response: ijiḷi.
